Value objects wrapping a long. Swapping questionId and voterId becomes a compile error.

g.text: THE HEADLINE BUG — a lock that protected the wrong thing
The old code did synchronized (voteKey.intern()). Two problems: (a) an interned
string is a JVM-wide monitor any unrelated code can share; (b) the lock was per
(voter, target) but the counters are per TARGET — so two different voters
serialized against nobody and voteCount += n lost updates.
MEASURED — 200 distinct voters on one question
Reputation was worse than the score — same race on reputation += points.
In a real DB, votes gets a UNIQUE constraint on (voter_id, target_type,
target_id) and the counters become UPDATE ... SET score = score + ?.
The CAS and the unique index are the same idea at two layers.
Patterns: Facade · Strategy ×2 (reputation, search) · Observer (listeners) · Value Object (Tag) · Command-ish VoteTarget
State REJECTED for QuestionStatus — two states, one transition; a hierarchy would be ceremony over a boolean
